paragraphs: The XF 2.0i is part of the X260 generation of the Jaguar XF, introduced in 2015. It uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine — a turbocharged unit shared across several Ford and Jaguar models of that era. The 2.0i was available in early X260 models as a petrol alternative to the diesel-badged variants. Jaguar XF 2.0i Engine Compatibility The XF 2.0i uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre petrol engine across its entire production run. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford EcoBoost engines for every XF 2.0i on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF 2.0i from 2023 to present. The Ford EcoBoost features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford EcoBoost V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford EcoBoost rebuild.
